titleEn: Smallest Subtree with all the Deepest Nodes
title: 具有所有最深节点的最小子树
summary: 返回包含二叉树全部最深节点的最小子树根节点。
insight: 后序递归同时返回子树最大深度和其最深节点的最小公共祖先；左右深度相等则当前节点是答案，否则答案继承更深一侧。
pitfalls: 单个最深节点时返回该节点本身
左右同深时即使都为空也返回当前叶节点

solutions.title: 后序返回深度与答案
solutions.idea: 自底向上比较左右子树最深层。
steps: 取得 left、right；若深度相等返回 depth+1,node=current
否则返回较深一侧 depth+1 及其 node；根调用的 node 即答案

code.java: class Solution { public TreeNode subtreeWithAllDeepest(TreeNode root){return dfs(root).node;}private Result dfs(TreeNode node){if(node==null)return new Result(0,null);Result left=dfs(node.left),right=dfs(node.right);if(left.depth==right.depth)return new Result(left.depth+1,node);return left.depth>right.depth?new Result(left.depth+1,left.node):new Result(right.depth+1,right.node);}private static class Result{int depth;TreeNode node;Result(int depth,TreeNode node){this.depth=depth;this.node=node;}} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun subtreeWithAllDeepest(root:TreeNode?):TreeNode?=dfs(root).second;private fun dfs(node:TreeNode?):Pair<Int,TreeNode?>{if(node==null)return 0 to null;val left=dfs(node.left);val right=dfs(node.right);return if(left.first==right.first)left.first+1 to node else if(left.first>right.first)left.first+1 to left.second else right.first+1 to right.second} }
code.cpp: class Solution { pair<int,TreeNode*> dfs(TreeNode* node){if(!node)return{0,nullptr};auto left=dfs(node->left),right=dfs(node->right);if(left.first==right.first)return{left.first+1,node};return left.first>right.first?make_pair(left.first+1,left.second):make_pair(right.first+1,right.second);}public:TreeNode* subtreeWithAllDeepest(TreeNode* root){return dfs(root).second;} };
